description_en: Creates a role tag for an instance node
description_zh: 创建实例节点角色标签
name: CreateNodeRoleTag

parameters.help_en:
The shard node ID.
This parameter is available only when you create a role tag for a shard node of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
Shard节点ID。
当为分片集群实例Shard节点创建角色标签时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: shard_list

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request and prevents duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run without calling the API operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): Sends the request. If the request passes the check, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
